Split PDF

Split PDF online free by extracting only the pages you need. Enter a page range like 1-3, 5 and download a new PDF with just those pages — processed privately in your browser, never uploaded.

🔒 Your files never leave your device.

How to use

  1. Choose the PDF you want to split.
  2. Type the pages to keep, using ranges and commas — for example 1-3, 5.
  3. Press Extract pages and download the new smaller PDF.

How it works

A PDF library (pdf-lib) loads on demand in your browser, reads the page count, copies only the pages in your range into a fresh document, and offers it as a download. Invalid page numbers are ignored safely, and the tool tells you if no valid pages remain.

Worked example: Example: from a 20-page bank statement, extract pages 1-2 only for an application that asks for the summary pages.

Frequently asked questions

How do I write the page range?

Use commas for separate pages and hyphens for ranges: 1-3, 5, 8-10 extracts pages 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9 and 10.

Is my PDF uploaded to a server?

No. Splitting happens in your browser on your device.

Can I split a password-protected PDF?

No — protected files must be unlocked first with their password in another app.

Will the extracted PDF keep its quality?

Yes. Pages are copied exactly as they are — no re-compression or quality loss.
